title: Hinomori Shizuku — Calm For The Hard Workers〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Here you are, Shizuku.
I brought the DVD recordings of Hiyori's TV appearances.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Airi...!
Wow, you recorded so many.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: These are her close-coverage interviews, and these are her music-program appearances. I even have recordings of when she was invited onto variety shows as a guest.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. With so many choices, I don't know where to begin. Which do you recommend, Airi...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, to start, I'd say this one...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Her second close-coverage documentary!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, isn't this the program you said you watched when you were little...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. But this is her second appearance, so you get to see her after she's grown as a professional!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Really...?!
I can't wait to watch it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Lemme pop in the DVD... Alright, let's watch.

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <The professional we'll be covering this week is the ever-popular idol, Hiyori, for a second time!>

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <Our last episode with her received an incredible response, and it's been one year since then. You'll get to see what Hiyori is up to nowadays.>

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line: <Would it be alright if I started by asking you about your schedule for today?>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <I'm off to do some voice training now, and I have a shoot afterwards... And later this evening, I have an interview for a magazine!>

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line: <I see. As packed a schedule as ever.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Yes, very packed...
Having to do all those things in one day seems so challenging.)

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <Hiyori has arrived at the studio where she'll be doing voice training. Today, we've been given special permission to film as she practices her new song.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <Oh, I'm sorry. Would you be okay with me singing the chorus here with a little more energy? I'm hoping that I can give my listeners a boost of encouragement that way...>

rows.Speaker: Voice Teacher
rows.Line:
<Yes, I see.
Then, let's do a take with you singing just like that.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <Thank you!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wow, she sounds completely different...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really see what she means about sounding more encouraging.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Pretty amazing, right? She has this way of lighting your heart on fire. Just listening to her fills me with all this energy...

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <Following her voice-training session, we find her in the green room at a TV station.>

rows.Speaker: Program Staff Member
rows.Line: <I'm looking forward to working with you today, Hiyori!>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line:
<Likewise!
Oh, please have some of these if you like.>

rows.Speaker: Program Staff Member
rows.Line:
<Wow, thank you!
Wait, these are those chick cookies everybody's been talking about lately!>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line:
<Hehe. That's right.
I brought enough for the entire staff, so I hope you all get to have some!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Despite having such a busy schedule, she found the time to buy snacks for the staff...)

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <Day three. Today, we're at a meet-and-greet photo-op event.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <You saw me on that show? Thank you so much!>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <Oh, the pose from that time? Hehe. No problem. To your heart from mine, here's a Hiyori peace sign☆>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Hehe. That's so cute.
Any fan would become even more passionate after seeing that.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She even fulfilled all the other requests that her fans asked of her. Not only that, she and the regulars seemed like old friends...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She really is a wonderful idol.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (No matter how busy she is, she's always doing her best with a smile to bring her fans energy. And she's so kind to the staff...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She brings cheer to everybody around her.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Huh...? Wait, that also applies to...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was just thinking how you and Hiyori are so alike.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you think so?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The way she posed with her fans at that event reminded me of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I appreciate you saying that, since the way I interact with my fans is based on what I've seen her do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's like a big relay...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A relay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. She passed the baton to you, which you carried forward. Then, you passed it to me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've been copying you quite a lot because I want to be just like you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In that case, let's keep copying each other.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You've also given me a ton of gifts.
So, let's keep doing our best by making the most of the things we've given each other.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
